Package ui

Class GuestScreen

java.lang.Object
ui.GuestScreen
public class GuestScreen extends Object
JavaFX controller for the Guest Registry screen (GuestScreen.fxml).

This screen is the default landing screen of the MIRAGE application. It provides two forms and a read-only table view:

  • Register New Guest — collects name, email, phone, and loyalty tier, then persists a new Guest via GuestDAO.
  • Update Loyalty Tier — looks up a guest by ID and updates their tier, which also triggers an audit log entry in loyalty_tier_log.
  • Guest Table — displays all registered guests, refreshed after every write operation.

The controller is instantiated and injected by the JavaFX FXMLLoader when GuestScreen.fxml is loaded. All @FXML-annotated fields are injected before initialize() is called.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public void initialize() throws SQLException
      Called automatically by the JavaFX runtime after all @FXML fields have been injected.

      Responsibilities:

      • Populates both loyalty-tier combo boxes with the four valid tier values.
      • Binds each table column to the corresponding Guest property via PropertyValueFactory.
      • Instantiates GuestDAO and performs the initial guest list load.
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the database connection cannot be established

    • loadAllGuests

      private void loadAllGuests() throws SQLException
      Fetches all guests from the database and refreshes the table view. Called on initialisation and after every write operation to keep the table in sync with the database.
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the database query fails

    • registerGuest

      private void registerGuest() throws SQLException
      Handles the "REGISTER GUEST" button action.

      Validates that all fields are filled and a tier is selected, then creates and persists a new Guest. Clears the form and refreshes the table on success. Shows a warning alert on validation failure or database error.

      Throws:
      SQLException - if the database insert fails

    • clearGuest

      private void clearGuest()
      Handles the "CLEAR" button action on the Register New Guest form. Resets all input fields and the tier combo box to their empty state.

    • updateGuestTier

      private void updateGuestTier() throws SQLException
      Handles the "UPDATE TIER" button action.

      Validates that a numeric guest ID and a new tier have been provided, then calls GuestDAO.updateLoyalityTier(int, String) which updates the guest record and writes an audit log entry. Refreshes the table and clears the update form on success.

      Throws:
      SQLException - if the database update fails
